rules.matchersWeakenedNote: No matcher was replaced by a weaker one on the same read (no toHaveTextContent→toBeInTheDocument, no exact→regex, no queryBy for getBy, no removed `not`, no conditional helper skipping an implicit check). Two exact reads became stronger (the urgency state heading regex → its exact name; the effects-off frame-rear toBe(false) → toEqual({ inDialog: 0, background: null }) plus a no-rear count). Reads dropped, re-pointed or relaxed because Round 7 draws a different scene or markup are each listed in readsDroppedOrRelaxed with the owner decision or the standing rule that places them — among them three relaxations a reviewer should see: the gallery urgency case's urgent-timer count 2 → 1 (Round 7's state has no log with its own timer; the route case still reads two), [data-urgent] → [data-urgent="true"], and the shipped primary glow exempt from the foreground-filter read. Every body-level matcher lost against the base or the build is accounted for in selfCheck.bodies.
